A type of '''repulsorcraft''' with a pod-like design was used by [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]].<ref name="SSW" />

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Jawa Pods are enemies in the [[Wikipedia:Super Nintendo Entertainment System|Super Nintendo]] videogame ''[[Super Star Wars]]''. Players first encounter them on "Level 2: Tatooine I." The enemies hover around player's speeder, throwing [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]].
